sections.scene: Before sunrise on a rain-polished railway platform, <Subject 1>, a tired courier in a charcoal coat, waits beside a silver case as an empty train approaches through blue mist.
sections.shot_list: 0.00-1.50s: hold a medium-wide profile and establish the empty platform. 1.50-3.70s: the train enters and moving reflections cross <Subject 1>. 3.70s-end: <Subject 1> turns toward camera and grips the case.
sections.acting: Tension begins in the shoulders, then the eyes react, then one deliberate turn. Preserve natural blinking, breathing and restrained hand movement.
sections.light_and_image: Cool predawn ambience, practical sodium lamps, wet reflections, realistic skin texture, restrained contrast and cinematic depth without artificial glow.
sections.camera: One slow lateral tracking move at chest height with mild foreground parallax; maintain one lens language and do not cut.
sections.production_sound: Distant rail vibration, light rain on the metal roof, one approaching brake squeal, coat movement and close dialogue with platform reflections.
sections.non_diegetic_music: A sparse low cello pulse enters only after the train becomes visible, beneath the physical scene sound.
sections.negatives: No identity drift, duplicate people, wardrobe change, warped hands, sudden zoom, jump cut, subtitles, text or logo.
